notes: The instruction set is internally in tension on a universal over a copular predicate: the Quantifiers section says such a universal distributes to a rule and 'never (Inheritance <kind> <prop>)', while the same section's closing parenthetical says copular universals stay the single Inheritance fact ('all dogs are mammals'); the parse takes the latter, which fits a bare-kind subject with no definite set. Two QuantifierPhrase companions are emitted for one surface quantifier phrase 'each' (one per predicate atom) — defensible under 'mandatory for every explicit quantifier word the claim consumes' but in tension with 'one companion per explicit quantifier PHRASE'.
